blocks.text: A CUDA block reuses tiles of A and B while accumulating one output tile. The task is: Multiply nonaliasing row-major float matrices A(M,K) and B(K,N) into C(M,N). Implement 16x16 shared-memory tiles with masked boundary loads; dimensions are positive.
The function has no explicit input arguments. The animation follows the supplied implementation, so every highlighted operation connects to code you can inspect.
